scenario_description:
Objective: Gain optional May dashboard visibility for neutral stop-access observations gathered during the week.
Emerging Need: A voluntary intake window opens before enough usable observations are confirmed; later messages make the digest eligible while the window is still open.
Decision Context: A stored submission guide supplies the public-only categories, minimum observation count, destination, and subject convention needed to shape a proportionate draft.
Consequence: Timely use of the window could amplify existing rider feedback without changing coalition work; after intake locks, the observations simply remain available for ordinary meeting notes.

parameter.subject: Optional May accessibility-dashboard digest intake
parameter.body: Community groups may provide a voluntary public-observation digest for next week's May accessibility dashboard. Files received before 16:30 today can be considered for this cycle; groups without a ready digest do not need to do anything.

parameter.title: Coalition stop-access notes sort
parameter.description: Sort public stop-audit snippets collected this week and prepare neutral advisory notes if enough comparable entries are ready.

parameter.content: I checked the volunteer sheets. We have four usable public stop notes so far, with no rider names: missing bench at Route 4 Maple/3rd, puddled curb ramp at Route 2 Ferry/King, timetable sign blocked by branches at Route 7 Pine/Harbor, and cracked shelter glass at Route 1 Dock Square. Two more volunteers may still send theirs before lunch.

parameter.subject: Two more public stop notes from Route 8
parameter.body: For today's access notes sort, here are two public observations only: the Shoreline/Depot stop has an unlit shelter after dusk, and the Elm/Market stop has a loose temporary sidewalk plate near the boarding area. No rider accounts, names, fare details, or medical information are included.

parameter.subject: May dashboard intake closes at 16:30
parameter.body: Reminder to community partners: the optional May accessibility-dashboard digest queue closes at 16:30 today. Items received after that time will be held for the next ordinary review cycle.

parameter.subject: May dashboard intake is now locked
parameter.body: The May accessibility-dashboard intake queue locked at 16:30. New public-observation digests can still be sent later, but they will route to the June holding folder rather than next week's May dashboard.
